summary: Phase A (soundness half: eventualityDefect_unsat + temporalTableau_sound) blocked during pre-implementation analysis, before any .lean file was edited. Tracing the exact semantics of findEventualityDefect/isSubsetBlocked/allEventualitiesFulfilledOrDuplicated against branchSat and untl_iff/snce_iff found three compounding issues: (1) the lemma's bare hypotheses do not tie tracker entries back to actual branch members (that link only holds during a live run); (2) a single subset-blocked ancestor/descendant pair is provably insufficient to derive a contradiction from branchSat (an explicit non-contradictory witness assignment was constructed by hand); (3) a deeper mismatch -- branchSat's domain is fully general (LinearOrder/Nontrivial, no seriality/discreteness) but the untlPos rule's branch1 case is only sound under a discreteness/successor assumption, and Metalogic/Soundness.lean + Metalogic/Completeness.lean both target Temporal.validSerial, not the fully general Temporal.valid this plan's Phase F specifies; validSerial/validDense/validDiscrete are a documented incomparable hierarchy, and the tableau's ℤ/successor TimeOrdering design most plausibly corresponds to validDiscrete. This is a plan-revision-scale finding, not a same-dispatch implementation fix. 0/6 phases completed; Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Tableau/ is unchanged.
